theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbs_tfa_fixed_support_dense
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → ∃ D : Set (TestFormOn U n), D.Countable ∧ (∀ η ∈ D, tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η ∈ D, (∀ x, dist ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) < ε) ∧ ∀ x, dist (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) < ε
